♦️ **FLEX GUI PRO V9.3.0 YA FITO! (AFTER EFFECTS)**

**MAP RIGS 2.0**, AutoCaptions tare da rubutunka (**Your script**) da **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe**, da kuma **Flex Studio (Beta)** wanda yake fara saukewa sannan ya tambaye ka kafin ya girka.

*(Ka girka a kan sigarka ta yanzu sannan ka sake kunna After Effects sau ɗaya.)*

♦️ **Sabo: MAP RIGS 2.0**
* Tsarin **Map desk**, neman wurare ba tare da intanet ba, **Quick looks** (Country Pop, Space Dive, Trip Route da sauransu), Stick to Map, Clean labels, Always Sharp, salon taswira kyauta da **Open in Flex Maps**.
* Ƙarin kayan aikinsa (daidaitawa kai tsaye, salo, lakabi, 3D, Finalize) yanzu suna lodawa da gaske a cikin After Effects.

♦️ **Sabo a AutoCaptions**
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (a gajimare, yana amfani da kiredit na Flex AI) shi ne injin da ake ba da shawara, an zaɓe shi sau ɗaya ga kowa. Ka sake zaɓar Whisper don yin rubutun ƙasa kyauta a kwamfutarka (Translate To yana buƙatar Whisper). Idan sabar tana cike da aiki, za ta nuna maka matsayinka a layi.
* **Your script**: rubutun ƙasa suna ɗaukar haruffa da kalmomin rubutunka a duk inda ka faɗi waɗannan kalmomin.
* Fitarwar **Editable template**: rubutun ƙasa a matsayin layer na samfuri waɗanda za ka iya sauya salonsu a Essential Properties (After Effects 2026).
* Ba ka zaɓi komai ba kuma Source media babu komai? Zai ba ka **dukan composition**. Sauti iri ɗaya yana sake amfani da rubutun maganarsa.

♦️ **Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** yana saukewa, sannan ya tambaya **Install / Not now**.
* Manhajar (2.0.0-beta.2): wuraren aiki **PRO, TRACK, ROTOSCOPE, COLOR GRADING**, maɓallan kayan aikin After Effects, klip suna buɗewa nan take, kuma OPEN yana aiki a kan precomp da adjustment layer.

♦️ **An gyara**
* Tasirin jigo da suka ɓace a kwamfutocin Windows da yawa sun dawo (sun fi sauƙi idan an kashe tasirin motsi na Windows).

♦️ **Wuri na zaɓi don kare lasisi**
* Ana tambaya sau ɗaya kawai, kuma na zaɓi ne: da **No thanks** komai yana ci gaba da aiki. Ka canza shi a **Flex Settings > Privacy**. Ana ajiye shi na watanni 12, ba a taɓa sayar da shi ba, kuma ba a taɓa raba shi ba sai inda doka ta buƙata.

ult.message:
♦️ **FLEX ULTIMATE V2.3.0 YA FITO! (PREMIERE PRO)**

**Caption Stack ya koma cikin AutoCaptions** tare da salo, tsari, motsi da sauti ga kowace kalma. **UN-NEST** da blend modes suna aiki a Premiere 26.5, **AUTO CUT** danna ɗaya ne kawai, kuma **Flex Studio (Beta)** yana buɗe klip ɗinka kai tsaye daga panel.

*(Ka girka a kan sigarka ta yanzu sannan ka sake kunna Premiere Pro sau ɗaya.)*

♦️ **Sabo: Rubutun ƙasa masu motsi a AutoCaptions**
* **Salon kalma**: ba kowace kalma launukanta, font ɗinta da ƙarewar Flat, Shine ko Glow.
* **Tsarin layi**: Stack, Over, Under, Beside da Line.
* **Motsi ga kowace kalma** (Fade, Pop, Rise, Type, Shake da sauransu) tare da samfoti, da kuma sautukan **Pop / Tick / Swoosh**. Salon kalmomi da motsi suna buƙatar fitarwar **Images**.
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (a gajimare, yana amfani da kiredit na Flex AI) yanzu shi ne injin da ake ba da shawara, an zaɓe shi sau ɗaya ga kowa; zaɓi injin Whisper don yin rubutun ƙasa kyauta ba tare da intanet ba.
* **Your script** (yanayin Captions): rubutun ƙasa suna ɗaukar kalmomin rubutunka inda ka faɗi waɗannan kalmomin.
* Idan ba a zaɓi komai ba (katin Source babu komai), zai ba ka **dukan timeline**; ana ajiye rubutun ƙasa kusa da aikinka.

♦️ **Sabo: Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Open in Flex Studio** yana bin diddigin klip ɗin a cikin manhajar; **APPLY TO PREMIERE** yana mayar da bin diddigin. Ba a girka ba? **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** yana saukar da shi, sannan ya tambaya **Install / Not now**.

♦️ **An canza**
* **AUTO CUT** yana nazarin klip da aka zaɓa kuma yana yanka da danna ɗaya. **Retakes** yana kama layukan da ka sake farawa.
* **Audio Studio** yanzu yana da ƙananan shafuka shida. **Library** yanzu yana cikin Nest Saver.

♦️ **An gyara**
* **UN-NEST** a Premiere 26.5 (yana ƙin kowane nest), da blend modes kamar Screen waɗanda suke komawa Normal (Premiere da Turanci).
* Alamar ja ta **AUTOSAVE 0:00**, baƙin samfotin Caption Stack, da tasirin jigo da suka ɓace a kwamfutocin Windows da yawa.

♦️ **Wuri na zaɓi don kare lasisi**
* Ana tambaya sau ɗaya kawai, kuma na zaɓi ne: da **No thanks** komai yana ci gaba da aiki. Ka canza shi a **Flex Settings > Privacy**. Ana ajiye shi na watanni 12, ba a taɓa sayar da shi ba, kuma ba a taɓa raba shi ba sai inda doka ta buƙata.
